label: Form Placement
description: OBSERVATIONAL: form prominence / above-the-fold position vs peer form-CR.
moderators: Intent-gated: correlation with over-peer CR is +0.08 on high-action, +0.06 on contact, ~0 on home (exp-0040).
caveats: OBSERVATIONAL association, NOT causal: ~80-93% confounding; causal ATE ~0 and not significant after adjusting intent/traffic/site (exp-0041).
Use as a peer-benchmark / triage signal ('is this form-CR good for this page?'), not a 'move-the-form-causes-+X%' lever.
Vertical coverage is near-zero on these pages (vertical_labels built for the A/B corpus only) — slice by intent/traffic instead.
